scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts ShortEdit out/raw.mp4 && npm run limit
scripts.limit: ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af alimiter=limit=0.89:level=disabled -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/edited.mp4
scripts.render:card: remotion render src/index.ts CardPull out/card_raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/card_raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af alimiter=limit=0.89:level=disabled -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/flagg_edit.mp4
